messages:
Alex P.: hey team — hitting a weird thing during onboarding. Trying to register my passkey (Yubi) in Okta but the browser just sits on 'Waiting for authenticator' forever. Tried twice. Anyone seen this?
Samir K.: which browser/os? did you try incognito? usually clears stray cookies. also: are you on the company VPN? that can block CTAP sometimes.
Alex P.: MacBook Air M1, macOS 13.6, Chrome stable. Not on VPN. Incognito didn't help. I also just noticed 1Password says my SSO invite is 'pending' even though I got the okta prompt.
Jamie L.: sometimes the Google account provisioning lags — 1Password can be stuck until the Google Workspace account fully syncs. How long since you accepted the org invite?
Alex P.: accepted the welcome email ~12m ago.
IT Bot: We detected a short provisioning delay for new hires in the us-west region—automatic retries in progress. If still blocked after 20 minutes, file a ticket or reply here with your Okta username so IT can reprovision.
Amara (People Ops): looping in @Samir. Alex — can you paste your Okta username (no passwords) so we can force a reprovision if needed? Also sorry about the friction, we pushed a tiny sync fix this morning. :grimacing: 
Alex P.: ok it's alex.p@redwood.dev
Samir K.: thanks. i'm going to clear your device registrations and trigger a reprovision on the backend. quick troubleshooting steps while i do that: (1) remove Yubi from macOS passkeys if it shows up, (2) reboot the key, (3) try an incognito window. i'll post once done.
Samir K.: (system) forced reprovision executed for alex.p@redwood.dev — clearing device registrations and resending SSO session.
Samir K.: also check this if chrome is flaky: go to Settings → Privacy and security → Clear site data for `okta.com` + `1password.com`, then reopen incognito.
Alex P.: did that, opened incognito, tried to add passkey, chrome shows the Yubi light blink but then error: "Authenticator response error"
Jamie L.: quick sanity: is your Yubi firmware up to date? on mac sometimes older firmware plays badly with CTAP2. also try Safari — it tends to handle passkeys differently.
Alex P.: tried Safari private window — same behavior. firmware is recent per Yubico tool.
Samir K.: ok i pushed a manual provisioning and forced the 1Password invite to complete from our side. you shouldsee a new invite link in your personal email (sent from 1password+okta@redwood.dev). also temporarily turned off the 'require FIDO resident key' flag for your account to let you register.
IT Bot: 1Password provisioning status: completed for alex.p@redwood.dev. Okta device registration: cleared -> ready.
Alex P.: got the 1Password email, clicked and was able to sign in. reattempting passkey registration now...
Alex P.: success! passkey registered and I can SSO into 1Password. thanks everyone :tada:
Samir K.: great — leaving a note in onboarding playbook: if passkey registration fails, clear site data, try incognito, attempt another browser, and ping #new-hires with your Okta username for forced reprovision. i'll also add a quick link to the Yubi firmware check. :memo:
Amara (People Ops): thanks for the patience Alex, welcome aboard again! we'll follow up with a short survey on the onboarding flow.
Alex P.: appreciate it — everything's green now. feel free to close out.
Samir K.: closing out here; reach back if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
